job.name: ig25_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, женщина ~32 на записи подкаста, микрофон на стойке перед ней, смотрит чуть мимо камеры на собеседника (так задумано), губы приоткрыты, без надписей
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущая подкаста ~32: каштановые волосы в низком хвосте, шалфейная шёлковая блуза, тёплая студия с книжными полками
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame from a video podcast. A calm, warm Russian woman about 32 with chestnut-brown hair in a low loose ponytail, a few strands framing her face, small pearl earrings, a sage-green silk blouse, sitting in a light linen armchair. A black podcast microphone on a boom arm in front of her chest (NOT covering the mouth). She looks slightly to the left of the camera at an interlocutor, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, thoughtful, NO smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: a cosy dimly lit studio with wooden bookshelves, warm practical lamps and a plant, blurred. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
